name: github/blame complete route (CHAOS-3335 + CHAOS-3343)
$limitation: The plan targets each implemented correctness class independently: complete-inventory capping, resumable persisted selection, per-file error and rate-limit semantics, empty-path progress, timestamp precision, live-Python parity, complete readback comparison, tenant/repository isolation, explicit progress-before-blame ordering, and production construction. The independent route switch remains default-off. The full production-executor PostgreSQL plus ClickHouse crash window remains an integration proof because its cross-store process-death setup is not a single-clause source predicate.

mutations.rationale: a repository exceeding the bounded complete unit must fail before any partial blame inventory can be written or its watermark advanced
only a provider rate limit aborts the unit; a non-rate GraphQL error must be recorded for that path while later files continue
last_synced must be stabilized to ClickHouse DateTime64(3) precision so exact crash readback does not classify the persisted row as divergent
the Go row constructor must preserve the active Python producer's Unknown author-name fallback rather than silently emitting an empty author
a persisted author_name mismatch at the expected version must report EffectConflict instead of letting crash recovery mark a divergent row committed

mutations.find: WHERE org_id = ? AND repo_id = ? AND path = ? AND line_no = ?
mutations.replace: WHERE org_id != ? AND repo_id = ? AND path = ? AND line_no = ?
mutations.rationale: readback must reconcile only the owning tenant's natural key; selecting another tenant's colliding row must never classify the local effect exact
readback must resolve the winning ReplacingMergeTree version; reading physical versions makes exact recovery ambiguous after an older row exists
each successful bounded sync must exclude paths already durable for the owning tenant or every retry will burn quota on the same prefix
a colliding repository UUID under another tenant must never suppress the owning tenant's unblamed path
the production binary must construct the durable coverage reader with the same live lease as the blame effect sink

mutations.find: WHERE org_id = ? AND repo_id = ? AND tree_ref = ?
mutations.replace: WHERE org_id = ? AND repo_id != ? AND tree_ref = ?
mutations.rationale: progress for a second repository in the same organization must not suppress or reconstruct paths for the claimed repository
the progress identity must be committed before git_blame even when a caller supplies effects in reverse order
a zero-range path marker must become durable completion without inventing a git_blame row or selecting the path forever
an existing effect ledger must invoke generation-aware collection before ordinary coverage can exclude accepted rows and change the manifest
a writing progress effect that reached ClickHouse must preserve its original manifest; treating it as absent discards accepted effect identity and refetches mutable provider results
the transactional reset must reject a stale probe snapshot if any effect status changed before the PostgreSQL row lock was acquired
